digest.component_or_area: rebar init store-mount / branch bootstrap gate
propositions: A failed or timed-out tickets-branch fetch causes rebar init to silently create an empty divergent orphan store instead of failing closed.
A shared tri-state remote-branch probe using git ls-remote must distinguish advertised, reachable-absent, and unreachable states and be consumed by all four init consumers.
When the remote advertises the branch but fetch fails, init must return nonzero without creating an orphan and emit diagnostics naming remote and branch.
When the remote is unreachable or times out, strict init and auto-init fail closed within one probe bound without prompting or orphaning unless override is supplied.
A new --force-new-store CLI flag and force_new_store keyword permit deliberate bootstrap only when reachability is unknown, and are ineffective (warn) when the remote is reachable.
The tri-state probe result is cached under a short TTL keyed by repo, remote, and branch so one CLI invocation performs at most one probe, re-probing after the TTL expires.
